examples.label: Website field in a profile form
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-url-field" site="Global" id="profile-website" name="website" value="" size="small" space="small" floating="outer" label="Website" placeholder="https://example.com" description="Shown on your public author page.">
  <:start_section>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-globe-alt" class="size-4" />
  </:start_section>
</.component>

examples.label: Webhook endpoint field with a saved value
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-url-field" site="Global" id="integration-webhook-url" name="webhook_url" size="small" space="small" floating="inner" label="Endpoint URL" value="https://hooks.example.com/mishka/orders">
  <:end_section>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-arrow-top-right-on-square" class="size-4 opacity-70" />
  </:end_section>
</.component>

examples.label: Social profile field showing a validation error
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-url-field" site="Global" id="profile-linkedin" name="linkedin" size="small" space="small" floating="outer" label="LinkedIn profile" value="linkedin.com/in/emily-carter" errors={["Please include https:// at the start of the address"]}>
  <:start_section>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-link" class="size-4" />
  </:start_section>
</.component>
